articles.title_original: Ukraine war briefing: Zelenskyy reaches out to eastern Europe for new trade and security partnership
articles.title_zh: Ukraine war briefing: Zelenskyy reaches out to eastern Europe for new trade and security partnership
facts_zh:
- 
  Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy launched on Friday a new trade and security scheme with a group of eight countries from the Carpathian region of central and eastern Europe.
In a comment summing up the outcome of the meeting, Zelenskyy said on Telegram that 50 agreements had been signed for a total value of more than €1bn ($1.15bn).
He gave few details, but said more than half the accords dealt with energy, particularly solar and wind power, with the aim of energy independence from Russia.

このニュースをシェア

Par Matthieu Le Gall
Cette colère sourde, en France, face à l’envolée des prix des carburants, qui s’échappe vers la surface comme les bulles d’une eau frémissante, est déjà entrée en ébullition ailleurs sur la planète.
Au Guatemala, en Syrie, des habitants protestent parfois violemment.

articles.title_zh: 'We simply don't know' - JP Morgan struggling to forecast oil prices due to Trump's war with Iran
facts_zh:
'We simply don't know' - JP Morgan struggling to forecast oil prices due to Trump's war with Iran
- Published
Investment banking giant JP Morgan has said it is struggling to predict how oil prices will be impacted by the US-Iran war, telling investors in a rare note that "we simply don't know how to model the endgame".

The bank said it assumed at the start of the conflict that there would be "economic red lines" that the Trump administration would be unwilling to cross, and therefore it believed a deal would have been struck to open up the Strait of Hormuz shipping lane back in June.
It said such red lines included oil prices rising above $100 a barrel, inflation reaching 4%, gasoline topping $5 a gallon and rates on 10-year government borrowing hitting 5%.

facts_zh: 相信对于许多人来说，当被问及现在仍在持续的冲突的时候，第一时间想到的就是俄乌冲突。
从2022年爆发，到今年2026年，战争已经维持了4年的时间。而在这4年时间里，俄乌双方均为此付出了惨痛的代价，可冲突非但没有结束，反而愈演愈烈。
随着乌克兰在战场上逐渐陷入困境，特朗普上台后美俄在沙特举行了没有乌克兰参加的谈判，整个国际局势都在发生变化。
